name: alternating-rows
title: Alternating rows
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: Rows that pair an image, or a large typographic figure, with a short text, alternating sides on wide screens.

meta.useWhen: Each point has its own real image or one striking number, and the points read in order.
meta.avoidWhen: The rows would all use similar stock images, or there are more than five rows.
